status: Adopted primary-source-backed exact identities; original proposal and diagnostic evidence preserved.
scope: Bounded identity and independent fragrance/flavor membership verification for 16 additional aroma parents. No paper counts, code changes, database edits, active allowlist adoption, Site changes or live collection.
shared_eligibility: An unchanged parent must be central to aroma/perception, administered/assayed pharmacology or toxicology, intended aroma-parent production, or expressly measured parent volatility/partitioning/physical properties. Ingredient membership alone does not admit a paper. Exclude derivatives, complexes, scaffold libraries, substrate/reagent-only, solvent/vehicle-only, background/absence mentions, unrelated materials/polymers, insect-only applications, general herbal clinical studies and uncharacterized mixtures. An established ester or lactone is its own verified parent, not automatic evidence for every derivative of its precursor.
shared_status_caveat: Source ingredient membership, present regulatory authorization, safety and clinical efficacy are separate assertions. These entries establish membership and identity only; no unrestricted-use, approval, safety or therapeutic claim is made. Preserve study-specific purity, stereochemistry and formulation information.

chemicals.name: delta-decalactone
chemicals.source_authority: FEMA Flavor Ingredient Library; US FDA Substances Added to Food
chemicals.verified_use: flavor ingredient; flavoring agent or adjuvant
chemicals.membership_evidence: FEMA 2361 identifies CAS 705-86-2 with coconut flavor profile. FDA independently assigns explicit flavoring technical effect to the same CAS parent.
chemicals.identity_evidence: FDA food record supplies the pyranone/decan-5-olide aliases. FDA GSRS identifies the generic/racemic entry rather than a specified R or S enantiomer.
chemicals.identity_note: Distinct from gamma-decalactone CAS 706-14-9. Generic decalactone cannot select the ring position; preserve explicit enantiomer and racemate results rather than treating all stereochemical levels as equivalent.
scope_guards: Do not include decanoic acid, 5-hydroxydecanoic acid itself, generic lactones, functionalized lactones, ring-opening polymers, substrate-only transformations or derivatives by substring.
Specific R/S identities require source evidence; this entry does not establish a particular enantiomer's membership or effects.
chemicals.diagnostic_link: Membership evidence relevant to later explicit review of DOI 10.1021/jo00033a007; this proposal does not reclassify that paper or edit the frozen uncertain diagnostic.

chemicals.name: gamma-decalactone
chemicals.source_authority: FEMA Flavor Ingredient Library; US FDA
chemicals.verified_use: flavor ingredient; flavoring agent or adjuvant
chemicals.membership_evidence: FEMA 2360 gives CAS 706-14-9 and fat/fruit/lactone/peach flavor profile. FDA independently identifies explicit flavoring use.
chemicals.identity_evidence: FDA supplies the gamma-decanolactone, hexylbutyrolactone and furanone aliases; FEMA search supplies decan-4-olide.
chemicals.identity_note: CAS here is generic stereochemical parent. Do not silently merge enantiopure material, delta-decalactone or unspecified decalactone.
scope_guards: No broad decalactone or butyrolactone-family match. Exclude polymer/material, derivative and substrate-only studies unless an eligible unchanged-parent measurement or intended aroma-parent production is central.

chemicals.name: gamma-nonalactone
chemicals.membership_evidence: Individual NHPID chemical record identifies CAS 104-61-0 and explicit flavour-enhancer/fragrance-ingredient purposes; topical fragrance and oral flavor roles are distinguished in its restrictions.
chemicals.identity_evidence: NHPID supplies nonan-4-olide and pentylfuranone identity; FDA GSRS identifies the gamma-nonalactone record as racemic.
chemicals.identity_note: Preserve racemate versus enantiopure results and distinguish other nonalactone ring-position isomers.
scope_guards: Do not use generic nonalactone, gamma-lactone class or odorless substituted derivatives as exact matches. Mixture-only product assays do not establish parent activity.

chemicals.name: gamma-undecalactone
chemicals.membership_evidence: FEMA 3091 identifies CAS 104-67-6 with apricot/fruit flavor profile.
chemicals.identity_evidence: Individual FEMA record pairs this gamma-lactone name with CAS 104-67-6. Canonical orthographic forms only are proposed here, without relying on supplier trade-name aliases.
chemicals.identity_note: Do not infer a specific enantiomer from generic CAS/name. Aldehyde C-14 and peach aldehyde trade labels are omitted from automatic aliases because they can cause identity/category mistakes.
scope_guards: Other undecalactones and functionalized derivatives remain distinct. Require central unchanged parent rather than mixture, polymer or reagent-only uses.

chemicals.name: hydroxycitronellal
chemicals.source_authority: US FDA Substances Added to Food; FDA cosmetic fragrance list
chemicals.verified_use: flavoring agent or adjuvant; fragrance ingredient
chemicals.membership_evidence: FDA food record identifies CAS 107-75-5 and explicit flavoring use, FEMA 2583; FDA cosmetic page explicitly lists hydroxycitronellal as a fragrance ingredient.
chemicals.identity_evidence: FDA records supply exact hydroxy-octanal aliases; retained aldehyde names avoid a misleading octanol alias in a FEMA search snippet.
chemicals.identity_note: Generic stereochemistry does not establish R/S material. Distinct from citronellal, hydroxycitronellol, HICC/Lyral and acetals.
scope_guards: Do not match hydroxycitronellal dimethyl/diethyl/propylene-glycol acetals or generic hydroxycitronellol by substring. Preserve tested purity and stereo identity.

chemicals.name: cinnamyl alcohol
chemicals.source_authority: US FDA Substances Added to Food; FDA cosmetic fragrance list
chemicals.verified_use: flavoring agent or adjuvant; fragrance ingredient
chemicals.membership_evidence: FDA identifies CAS 104-54-1, FEMA 2294 and explicit flavoring use; FDA cosmetic list independently names cinnamyl alcohol.
chemicals.identity_evidence: Exact aliases are supplied by the FDA individual food record.
chemicals.identity_note: Do not assign generic cinnamyl-alcohol studies to an E/trans or Z/cis stereoisomer without evidence. Cinnamaldehyde, cinnamic acid and cinnamyl esters are distinct parents.
scope_guards: Cinnamyl alcohol is a common catalytic substrate: exclude synthesis of unrelated products, derivative libraries and reagent-only appearances unless intended aroma-parent production or eligible parent measurement is central.

chemicals.name: anisyl alcohol
chemicals.source_authority: FEMA Flavor Ingredient Library; FDA cosmetic fragrance list
chemicals.membership_evidence: FEMA 2099 identifies CAS 105-13-5 with flower/herb flavor profile. FDA cosmetic list independently names anisyl alcohol.
chemicals.identity_evidence: FEMA search aliases explicitly identify the para-methoxybenzyl alcohol parent. 4-Methoxy is the equivalent para positional notation.
chemicals.identity_note: Do not merge o-/m-methoxybenzyl alcohol or an unspecified o/m/p commercial mixture with para CAS 105-13-5.
scope_guards: Exclude anisyl protecting groups, anisyl alcohol as incidental substrate/reagent/solvent, anisaldehyde and anisyl esters by substring.

chemicals.name: geranyl acetate
chemicals.source_authority: FEMA Flavor Ingredient Library; FDA cosmetic fragrance list; NIST identity record
chemicals.membership_evidence: FEMA 2509 pairs CAS 105-87-3 with lavender/rose profile. FDA explicitly includes Geranyl Acetate in its added fragrance-substance list.
chemicals.identity_evidence: NIST identifies E-geranyl acetate CAS 105-87-3 and the exact listed ester aliases, separating Z-neryl acetate as a stereoisomer.
chemicals.identity_note: Neryl acetate, geraniol and mixed geranyl/neryl material are distinct. Preserve commercial purity and E/Z composition.
scope_guards: Existing geraniol membership does not by itself justify geranyl-esters; this ester is independently verified. Do not admit unrelated substituted geranyl compounds or an unspecified ester mixture.

chemicals.name: eugenyl acetate
chemicals.source_authority: US FDA Substances Added to Food; FEMA; FDA cosmetic fragrance list
chemicals.verified_use: flavoring agent or adjuvant; fragrance ingredient
chemicals.membership_evidence: FDA food record identifies CAS 93-28-7, FEMA 2469 and explicit flavoring use; FEMA gives floral profile. FDA cosmetic list also names Eugenyl Acetate.
chemicals.identity_evidence: Exact ester aliases come from the FDA individual food record.
chemicals.identity_note: Distinct from eugenol, methyl eugenol, isoeugenol and isoeugenyl acetate CAS 93-29-8.
scope_guards: Only unchanged eugenyl acetate is verified here; no automatic acceptance of generic acetylated eugenol derivatives, polymers or bioconjugates.

chemicals.name: alpha-terpinene
chemicals.source_authority: FEMA Flavor Ingredient Library; FDA cosmetic fragrance list; FAO/JECFA
chemicals.membership_evidence: FEMA 3558 identifies CAS 99-86-5 with lemon profile; FDA cosmetic list names Alpha-Terpinene.
chemicals.identity_evidence: FEMA and JECFA explicitly map alpha-terpinene to p-mentha-1,3-diene CAS 99-86-5.
chemicals.identity_note: Distinct from gamma-terpinene, terpinolene and terpineol. JECFA commercial specification permits secondary components; a commercial assay does not make them the same parent.
scope_guards: Generic terpinene does not establish alpha identity. Exclude oxidized terpinene products, terpene mixtures, atmospheric reaction-product-only, solvent-only and unrelated pesticidal studies.

chemicals.name: gamma-terpinene
chemicals.membership_evidence: FEMA 3559 identifies CAS 99-85-4 with bitter/citrus profile; FAO/JECFA independently lists it as flavoring with herbaceous-citrus aroma.
chemicals.identity_evidence: FEMA search and FAO specification explicitly map gamma-terpinene to p-mentha-1,4-diene CAS 99-85-4.
chemicals.identity_note: Distinct from alpha-terpinene and terpinolene. Preserve composition of terpene mixtures and commercial material.
scope_guards: Generic terpinene is ambiguous; no alpha/gamma interchange. Exclude oxidation/transformation-product, solvent-only, uncharacterized oil-mixture and insect-only applications.

chemicals.name: terpinolene
chemicals.source_authority: FEMA Flavor Ingredient Library; FDA cosmetic fragrance list
chemicals.membership_evidence: FEMA 3046 identifies CAS 586-62-9 with pine flavor profile. FDA cosmetic list names Terpinolene.
chemicals.identity_evidence: Individual FEMA record directly pairs the canonical name with CAS 586-62-9.
chemicals.identity_note: Do not confuse terpinolene, terpinenes and terpineol. Commercial terpinolene grades may contain other monoterpenes; preserve tested composition.
scope_guards: Exclude terpene mixtures without identified parent, oxidation-product-only, reagent/solvent-only and insect-only studies.

chemicals.name: (-)-sclareol
chemicals.source_authority: US FDA Substances Added to Food; FEMA; Health Canada
chemicals.verified_use: flavoring agent or adjuvant; fragrance ingredient
chemicals.membership_evidence: FDA identifies (-)-sclareol CAS 515-03-7 with explicit flavoring role and FEMA 4502. FEMA gives floral profile; Health Canada's full assessment independently documents use of sclareol itself in fine fragrances and as a perfumery fixative.
chemicals.identity_evidence: FDA's specified parent includes the (13R)-labd-14-ene-8,13-diol alias, and Health Canada supplies full absolute-identity nomenclature for CAS 515-03-7.
chemicals.identity_note: Generic sclareol needs CAS or matching stereo identity where ambiguity matters. Do not merge epi-sclareol, sclareol glycol, sclareolide or sclareol metabolites. Established fragrance membership is for the parent itself, not merely a clary-sage mixture.
scope_guards: Exclude clary sage/extract assays without measured parent, generic labdane antitumor scaffold libraries, analogues, complexes and precursor-only production of unrelated products. Preserve specified stereochemistry.

chemicals.name: hexadecanolactone
chemicals.source_authority: US FDA cosmetic fragrance list; Health Canada/ECCC screening assessment; official cosmetic ingredient annex
chemicals.membership_evidence: FDA explicitly lists Hexadecanolactone among added fragrance substances. Health Canada identifies hexadecanolide CAS 109-29-5 and states the assessed substances are used primarily as fragrances/fragrance ingredients.
chemicals.identity_evidence: Health Canada explicitly maps hexadecanolide to oxacycloheptadecan-2-one CAS 109-29-5 (C16H30O2); official SFDA annex entry 335 maps the same chemical/CAS to the cosmetic name Hexadecanolactone.
chemicals.identity_note: NOT Exaltolide. Exaltolide is pentadecalactone/oxacyclohexadecan-2-one CAS 106-02-5 (C15H28O2), a different ring size. Also distinct from unsaturated hexadecenlactone/Ambrettolide.
scope_guards: Do not broaden the ring-size parent to macrocyclic lactones generally, Exaltolide, ambrettolide, ring-opening polymers or derivatives. Commercial fragrance blends are mixtures, not this discrete parent.

chemicals.name: hexyl cinnamal
chemicals.source_authority: FEMA Flavor Ingredient Library; FDA cosmetic fragrance list; FDA GSRS
chemicals.membership_evidence: FEMA 2569 identifies alpha-hexylcinnamaldehyde CAS 101-86-0 as flavor ingredient. FDA cosmetic fragrance list independently includes hexyl cinnamaldehyde (rendered Hexyl cinnamaladehyde on that page).
chemicals.identity_evidence: FDA GSRS maps Hexyl Cinnamal, alpha-hexylcinnamaldehyde and 2-benzylideneoctanal to CAS 101-86-0.
chemicals.identity_note: Generic commercial E/Z identity is retained; do not silently identify an isolated geometric isomer. Distinct from cinnamaldehyde and alpha-amylcinnamaldehyde.
scope_guards: No generic cinnamal/cinnamaldehyde scaffold or hexyl-cinnamyl-alcohol matching. Exclude derivatives, complexes, product-mixture-only studies and incidental formula ingredients.

chemicals.name: amyl salicylate
chemicals.source_authority: US FDA cosmetic fragrance list; FDA Substances Added to Food identity record
chemicals.membership_evidence: FDA explicitly lists Amyl Salicylate among added fragrance substances. The independent FDA food inventory record establishes exact CAS/ester identity; its presence alone is not treated as evidence of a flavoring technical effect.
chemicals.identity_evidence: FDA individual inventory record gives CAS 2050-08-0 and pentyl 2-hydroxybenzoate/pentyl salicylate aliases.
chemicals.identity_note: This is the straight-chain pentyl ester, not isoamyl/isopentyl salicylate or other amyl isomers, and not amyl 4-dimethylaminobenzoate sunscreen chemistry.
scope_guards: Do not use broad amyl/salicylate or drug-family matching. Exclude other alkyl salicylates, salicylic-acid derivatives, solvent-only, UV-filter-only incidental formula components and generic salicylate pharmacology.

primary_membership_sources.authority: US FDA Substances Added to Food
primary_membership_sources.evidence: DELTA-DECALACTONE; CAS 705-86-2; explicit FLAVORING AGENT OR ADJUVANT; FEMA 2361.

delta_decalactone_membership_review.scope_of_this_finding: Independent aroma-parent membership is established. This finding alone does not establish that the original paper centrally studies unchanged parent, satisfies provider/date/type gates, or should be admitted.
delta_decalactone_membership_review.frozen_diagnostic_policy: Preserve the original uncertain judgment and its original evidence verbatim. If root later readjudicates using these newly verified sources, retain a separately dated amendment with rationale and provenance. No diagnostic was edited in this task.

identity_corrections_and_deferred_terms.decision: Reject alias equivalence; keep hexadecanolactone CAS 109-29-5 in the 16-parent proposal.
identity_corrections_and_deferred_terms.reason: Exaltolide is a separate verified fragrance parent, CAS 106-02-5, pentadecalactone/oxacyclohexadecan-2-one. It is not silently included as a synonym, extra molecule or 17th proposed parent in this bounded pass.

identity_corrections_and_deferred_terms.term: decalactone / nonalactone / undecalactone / terpinene without positional designation
identity_corrections_and_deferred_terms.decision: No automatic mapping to a proposed specific parent.
identity_corrections_and_deferred_terms.reason: Ring position and alpha/gamma identity are material chemical distinctions; only a separate CAS, structure or exact identity statement can resolve them.

identity_corrections_and_deferred_terms.term: enantiopure or enriched commercial fragrance grades
identity_corrections_and_deferred_terms.decision: Preserve study-specific stereochemistry and composition; no silent generic-to-specific CAS assignment.
identity_corrections_and_deferred_terms.reason: Generic/racemic ingredient evidence does not establish a specific enantiomer's properties or effects, and blended commercial material is not automatically pure parent.

notes: All 16 proposed names are absent from the inspected base/expanded/v2/v4 active parent-name lists.
This is a source-verified proposal for root review, not automatic allowlist activation or paper inclusion.
Primary official ingredient records and explicit odor/flavor profiles establish membership; generic medicinal plant, drug-scaffold, solvent-only or taste-only membership was not used.
FDA GSRS/UNII and NIST identity records support identity only when paired with separate ingredient-membership evidence.
Exact aliases are deliberately conservative; no broad scaffold/class terms, speculative trade-name bridges or CAS-based stereoisomer collapsing are proposed.
Shared eligibility and per-parent guards must be maintained before any discovery/classifier expansion.
